title: 第 56章 做客秦家

第 56章 做客秦家-《穿越60带着空间当保安》

王野回到家迎接他的依然是小丫头王笑笑。真是不白疼这个丫头呀！这每天的情绪价值绝对给拉的满满的。抱起小丫头举着高高进了家门。

一进家门，父母都坐在餐桌旁，王野说：“娘，还没做饭呀？那我去做。”

秦婉赶紧拦住王野说：“小野，你等会儿，我有话跟你说。”

王野抱着小丫头坐在餐桌旁说：“娘，出什么事儿了吗？”

秦婉说：“今天你们走了之后，你舅舅让我们今天去他家做客。”

王野说：“就这事儿呀？去就去呗！舅舅家肯定有好吃的。”

秦婉说：“我刚才跟你爹商量，要送点什么礼呢！咱这一大家子去空着手肯定不行，但是一般的东西也拿不出手呀！”

王野说：“就这事儿呀？你们在家等着吧！我出去一下，一会儿就回来。”

说完，王野把王笑笑递给王铁柱，自己骑着自行车出门了。王野一直骑到东直门外，到了平时跟龙哥交易的小树林。在小树林里，王野精神力进入空间看着有什么东西可以送礼。

金银古董就算了，这东西见不得光。王野从空间里拿出了十斤羊肉，二斤大白兔奶糖，一盒点心，想了一下又拿出一根20年的人参。

想想这些东西应该是很有面子了吧，把这些东西放进背篓里，又在小树林休息了一会儿，就回家了。

王野一到门口就又看到了一辆吉普，王野心想：“这是想低调都不行了，这一天天的总有吉普停在家门口，怎么可能不被人议论呢。”王野一进门就看见了一个熟人秦天熙。

秦婉赶紧上前说：“小野，我给你介绍一下，这是你表哥叫秦天熙，天熙啊，这就是我大儿子王野。”

王野伸出手说：“表哥好，没想到呀！咱俩还有这缘分。”

秦天熙握住王野的手说：“表弟好，是没想到，早知道你是我表弟，也不会起冲突了。”

秦婉好奇的说：“你俩认识？”

王野说：“上周末的时候见过。”

王野没有细说，要是让秦婉知道鲍鱼鱼翅啥的不好解释。

秦天熙说：“表弟......”。

王野打断说：“表哥，你还是叫我小野吧，表弟表弟的听着拗口。”

秦天熙说：“行，小野，你也直接叫我大哥就行。”

王野：“大哥好，叫着也亲。”

秦天熙继续说：“我爸让我来接你们，小野你看现在走行吗？”

王野说：“行，那咱走吧！”

王野背着竹篓抱着王笑笑，这小丫头只要王野在家肯定是让王野抱着。秦婉领着王江河，王铁柱跟着。到了门口，王野抱着王笑笑上了副驾驶，这一次是小丫头第二次坐车了，但是依然很兴奋，东张西望的。

王江河可是第一次坐，但是毕竟大一点儿，这孩子在后面坐的很拘谨。就连秦婉和王铁柱坐的也不是很自然。只有王野依旧是一脸嫌弃，这破车坐着是真不舒服，也不知道什么时候才可以买进口车。

没一会儿就到了大院，大院的门岗看见是秦天熙也没有询问就直接放行了。这里王野很熟悉，上周王野刚来过。经过了陈洛兮家又过了两栋小楼，秦天熙停下了车。

车刚停下，王野就看见一个十几岁的半大小子跑进了院子，边跑边喊：“爸，爸，我大哥回来了。”接着就见屋里乌泱泱出来一群人。

王野下了车，一手抱着王笑笑给后座的父母把门打开。刚下车秦伟就迎了上来，王野：“舅舅好。”

王笑笑见大哥喊人了，也学着喊人：“舅舅，舅舅。”

秦伟哈哈大笑着摸了摸小丫头的脑袋说：“笑笑好呀，笑笑真乖。”

秦婉下车看见秦伟也上前打着招呼。王江河也怯生生的叫了声舅舅。

When Wang Ye returned home, it was still the little girl Wang Xiaoxiao who greeted him.It's really not in vain to hurt this girl!This daily emotional value is absolutely full.He picked up the little girl and carried her high into the house.

As soon as he entered the house, his parents were sitting at the dining table. Wang Ye said, "Mom, haven't you cooked yet? I'll do it."

Qin Wan quickly stopped Wang Ye and said, "Xiaoye, wait a moment, I have something to tell you."

Wang Ye sat at the dining table with the little girl in his arms and said, "Mom, what happened?"

Qin Wan said: "After you left today, your uncle asked us to visit his house today."

Wang Ye said: "Is that all? Just go! There must be delicious food at my uncle's house."

Qin Wan said: "I just discussed with your father what kind of gift we should give you! As a big family, we definitely can't go empty-handed, but we can't give away ordinary things either!"

Wang Ye said: "Is that all? Just wait at home! I'll go out for a while and I'll be back soon."

After saying that, Wang Ye handed Wang Xiaoxiao to Wang Tiezhu and went out on his bicycle.Wang Ye rode all the way to the outside of Dongzhimen and reached the grove where he usually traded with Brother Long.In the grove, Wang Ye mentally entered the space to see if there was anything he could give as a gift.

Forget about gold, silver and antiques, these things will never see the light of day.Wang Ye took out ten kilograms of mutton, two kilograms of white rabbit toffee, and a box of snacks from the space. After thinking for a while, he took out a 20-year-old ginseng.

Thinking that these things should be very honorable, I put these things in the backpack, rested in the woods for a while, and then went home.

As soon as Wang Ye arrived at the door, he saw another jeep. Wang Ye thought: "I don't even want to keep a low profile. There are always jeeps parked in front of my house every day. How can I not be talked about." Wang Ye saw an acquaintance Qin Tianxi as soon as he entered the door.

Qin Wan hurriedly stepped forward and said, "Xiaoye, let me introduce you. This is your cousin named Qin Tianxi. Tianxi, this is my eldest son Wang Ye."

Wang Ye stretched out his hand and said, "Hello, cousin, I didn't expect this! We still have such a fate."

Qin Tianxi held Wang Ye's hand and said, "Hello cousin, I didn't expect that if I had known you were my cousin, there wouldn't have been any conflict."

Qin Wan said curiously: "You two know each other?"

Wang Ye said: "I met him last weekend."

Wang Ye did not elaborate. If Qin Wan knew about abalone and shark fin, it would be difficult to explain.

Qin Tianxi said: "Cousin...".

Wang Ye interrupted and said, "Cousin, you should call me Xiaoye. It sounds hard to speak to my cousin."

Qin Tianxi said: "Okay, Xiaoye, you can just call me big brother."

Wang Ye: "Hello, big brother, I will kiss you even if you call me."

Qin Tianxi continued: "My dad asked me to pick you up. Xiaoye, do you think you can walk now?"

Wang Ye said: "Okay, let's go!"

Wang Ye carried the bamboo basket and hugged Wang Xiaoxiao. This little girl would definitely be held by Wang Ye as long as Wang Ye was at home.Qin Wan led Wang Jianghe, and Wang Tiezhu followed.When they arrived at the door, Wang Ye hugged Wang Xiaoxiao and got into the passenger seat. This was the second time for the little girl to ride in the car, but she was still very excited and looked around.

This was Wang Jianghe's first time sitting, but after all, he was older, so the child sat very reservedly in the back.Even Qin Wan and Wang Tiezhu didn't sit very naturally.Only Wang Ye still looked disgusted. It was really uncomfortable to sit in this old car, and he didn't know when he would be able to buy imported cars.

After a while, they arrived at the compound. The gate post of the compound saw that it was Qin Tianxi and let him through without asking.Wang Ye is very familiar with this place. Wang Ye just came here last week.After passing Chen Luoxi's house and passing two small buildings, Qin Tianxi stopped the car.

As soon as the car stopped, Wang Ye saw a teenage boy running into the yard, shouting: "Dad, Dad, my eldest brother is back." Then he saw a group of people coming out of the house.

Wang Ye got out of the car, holding Wang Xiaoxiao in one hand and opening the door for his parents in the back seat.As soon as he got off the car, Qin Wei came up to him and Wang Ye said, "Hello, uncle."

Wang Xiaoxiao saw that his elder brother was calling people, so he also learned to call people: "Uncle, uncle."

Qin Wei laughed and touched the little girl's head and said, "It's good to laugh, Xiaoxiao is so good."

Qin Wan got out of the car and saw Qin Wei coming up to say hello.Wang Jianghe also timidly called his uncle.
